name: ring-spinner
title: Ring Spinner
description: A spinner whose arc stretches as it turns, fills to a known amount, and closes into a check or a cross.

perf.budget: One small Skia canvas driven by one clock on the UI thread while it spins. The clock stops once it shows progress, success or an error.

measurements.notes: The demo upload ring keeps counting, so it draws at rest; a settled spinner stops its clock.

a11y.reducedMotion: A still quarter arc while loading; progress, the check and the cross appear without drawing in.
a11y.screenReader: A progress indicator named by accessibilityLabel. It reports a percentage when given progress, reads Done or Failed when it settles, and announces the result.
